# Vue Star Rate (vue-js-star-rating)

> Zero-dependency Vue 3.5+ star rating component — keyboard accessible, TypeScript-first, half-star precision, Lucide / FontAwesome / custom icons, SSR & Nuxt ready.

**Package:** `vue-js-star-rating` · **License:** MIT · **Peer:** `vue ^3.5.0` · **Bundle:** ~4.6 KB gzip JS + ~0.75 KB gzip CSS for `import { VueStarRate }` (vue excluded; `useStarRating` alone is ~1 KB gzip)

Vue Star Rate is a modern, keyboard-accessible star rating component for Vue 3 applications. Built with `<script setup>`, `defineModel`, `useTemplateRef`, and TypeScript types. Both entry files (ESM and UMD) import only `vue` and contain all three icon providers (built-in SVG, Lucide, Font Awesome); nothing is lazy-loaded and `lucide-vue-next` is not needed. The Lucide provider draws Lucide's own star geometry inline as an SVG. The Font Awesome provider renders `<i>` elements with Font Awesome class names, so your app must load Font Awesome's stylesheet itself; without it the stars are invisible.

## Quick start

```bash
pnpm add vue-js-star-rating
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { VueStarRate } from 'vue-js-star-rating';
import 'vue-js-star-rating/dist/style.css';
const rating = ref(0);
</script>

<template>
  <VueStarRate v-model="rating" :allow-half="true" :show-counter="true" />
</template>
```

## Props

- `v-model` (`number`, default `0`) — current rating value
- `maxStars` (`number`, default `5`)
- `allowHalf` (`boolean`, default `false`) — enable 0.5 increments
- `size` (`'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'`, default `'md'`)
- `iconSize` (`number | { width, height }`) — override pixel size
- `iconProvider` (`'custom' | 'lucide' | 'fontawesome'`, default `'custom'`)
- `colors` (`Partial<StarColors>`) — `{ empty, filled, hover, half }`
- `animation` (`Partial<AnimationConfig>`) — `{ enabled, duration, type: 'scale'|'bounce'|'pulse'|'none' }`; not a full off-switch: interactive stars still scale to 1.1 on hover
- `readonly` (`boolean`, default `false`)
- `disabled` (`boolean`, default `false`)
- `clearable` (`boolean`, default `false`)
- `allowReset` (`boolean`, default `true`) — click active star again to reset
- `showCounter` / `counterTemplate` (default template `'{value} / {max}'`)
- `showTooltip` / `tooltipLabels` (`string[]`)
- `minRating` (`number`, default `0`) / `step` (`number`, default `1`)
- `rtl` (`boolean`; known gap: the half-star fill is still painted on the left side of the star and `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` are not mirrored) / `inline` (`boolean`; not implemented: no visual effect) / `gap` (`number`, px)
- `ariaLabel` (`string`, default `'Star rating'`) / `className` / `faIcons` / `customIcon` (not implemented: accepted but ignored; use the `icon` slot)

## Events

- `update:modelValue` (`number`) — emitted by `v-model`
- `change` (`value`, `oldValue`)
- `hover` (`number | null`)
- `focus` / `blur`

## Slots

- `icon` — scoped: `{ filled, half, size, color, index }`
- `counter` — scoped: `{ value, max }`
- `clear` — content of the clear button

## Keyboard

- `→` / `↑` — increase · `←` / `↓` — decrease
- `Home` — minimum · `End` — maximum
- `1`–`9` — jump to value · `0` — reset

## Accessibility

- Root `role="group"` with an `aria-label`; each star is a `<button type="button">` with `aria-pressed` and an `aria-label` such as "3 stars". The star hover animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Not audited against WCAG, so no conformance is claimed. Known gaps (low default color contrast on white, 16 px `xs` targets, a half value announced like the next whole number, the numeric value available as text only with `showCounter`) are listed in llms-full.txt, section 11.

## Exposed methods

`reset()`, `setRating(value)`, `getRating()`, `focus()`, `blur()`

## Peer dependencies

- `vue ^3.5.0` is the only peer dependency. There are no optional peers.
- `iconProvider="lucide"` needs nothing installed. `iconProvider="fontawesome"` needs Font Awesome's stylesheet loaded by your app, for example `import '@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css'`; without it the stars are invisible.
- Releases 2.0.0 to 3.1.0 imported `lucide-vue-next` at build time, so Vite, webpack, esbuild, Nuxt and Storybook builds fail unless it is installed; 3.1.0 also wrongly documented it as an optional peer (GitHub issue #13). Fixed in 3.1.1; see CHANGELOG.md.
